interface.signature: def solve(M: int, N: int, K: int) -> int:

preconditions.description: Input dimensions M, N, and K must satisfy the given constraints.

postconditions.description: The result is a non-negative integer modulo 998244353.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= x <= K for x in [M, N, K])
postconditions.description: The input values M, N, and K are within the specified bounds.

postconditions.expression: return_value == (P * pow(Q, -1, 998244353)) % 998244353 for some integers P, Q where Q is coprime with 998244353 and Q != 0
postconditions.description: The result is the modular inverse of the expected value of SCCs represented as a fraction P/Q, where Q is coprime with 998244353.

postconditions.expression: return_value == (sum((probability * num_sccs) for num_sccs, probability in enumerate(scc_distribution)) * total_possible) % 998244353
postconditions.description: The result is the expected value of the number of strongly connected components (SCC) in the graph, computed as the sum over all possible matrix configurations of (probability of configuration * number of SCCs in that configuration), modulo 998244353.
